name: Amatohara Hinomi
source:
[u][b]A Princess Reincarnated in Another World[/b][/u]
[b]SR Evaluation Value: 10/10[/b]
Occupation: Second-year student
Height:About average
Bust:Extremely large

Far beyond the dimensions of the world we live in lies another realm—Laurentide. At the heart of Laurentide stands the Divine Nation of Amato, ruled by the descendants of the heavens.
Hinomi was a princess of Amato. However...
Due to an unexpected twist of fate, she found herself reincarnated into another world, descending upon Earth—Japan. During this otherworldly reincarnation, she lost the mystical power she once possessed.
To return to her original world, she must "grow."
It was at that moment that she encountered the [url=/c150333]protagonist[/url], who had just arrived at the academy.

[i]What kind of girl is she?[/i]
Being of noble birth, she possesses a strong sense of pride and dignity. At first, she struggles to adapt to this world, but as she interacts with the protagonist, she gradually begins to change.
Though she is a princess, she is surprisingly very curious about lewd things.

「Love me with all your heart and soul. In return, I shall bring you pleasure...」
